function: OTFS receiver for underwater acoustic links: a CNN extracts channel features from delay-Doppler pilots, stacked with received data into a ResNet that detects symbols (p. 3, Sec. III).
system: Scalar OTFS link (no antenna array or RIS stated), underwater acoustic, 7 kHz carrier, 4 kHz bandwidth, (M,N) = (64,32), BPSK, embedded pilot, 6 paths (pp. 3-4).
method: Supervised deep learning: 3-layer CNN channel-feature extractor stacked with an improved ResNet (4 residual blocks), trained with MSE loss and Adam (p. 3).
data_channel: Own simulated UWA channel: 6 paths, Rayleigh gains, delays in [0,T/4], Doppler squint effect from [9]; 500,000 frames split 3:1:1 into training, validation, test (pp. 3-4).
test_conditions: Held-out test split (3:1:1) of the same simulated frames; results shown at maximum speeds 10 and 18 kn versus SNR; no unseen scenario tested (pp. 3-4).
baselines: Classical: Threshold-ZF, -LMMSE, -MP, OMP-L-LMMSE [8], perfect-CSI ZF/LMMSE/MP; learned: FCDNN [11], ResNet [12], CNN-FCDNN [14], CNN-ResNet (Fig. 5, p. 4).
metrics: BER versus SNR and SNR gain at a BER of 1e-3, training loss (MSE) versus epoch, memory, parameters, FLOPs (Figs. 4-5, Table I, pp. 4-5).
complexity: Table I (p. 5): S-CNN-ResNet has 20.70 Mbytes of memory, 4,996,384 parameters and 2.48e8 FLOPs, listed next to every baseline.
q1_support: p. 4: "We generate delays and Doppler shifts for 6 paths." Own simulator with Rayleigh gains; no 3GPP, standardized or measured channel is used anywhere in the paper.
q2_support: p. 3: "divided into the training, validation, and test sets in a ratio of 3:1:1" is a held-out part of the same data; p. 4 reports only BER versus SNR at 10 and 18 kn, with no unseen scenario or adaptation.
q3_support: p. 3: "The neural networks proposed in [11], [12] and [14] are compared." (learned); p. 1: "achieves a lower bit error rate (BER) compared to single network receivers, cascaded network receivers, and classic algorithm-based receivers"; Fig. 5, p. 4, has Threshold-ZF/LMMSE/MP and OMP-L-LMMSE.
q4_support: p. 5: "memory size, the number of learnable parameters" and FLOPs are evaluated; Table I lists 4996384 parameters and 2.48 x 10^8 FLOPs for S-CNN-ResNet.
q5_support: p. 3: "We generated 500,000 OTFS frame samples under DSE UWA channels." Own simulated data; no code or data link and no public or measured dataset in the 5 pages.
notes: Area 4 (OTFS): CNN channel-feature extraction from delay-Doppler pilots plus ResNet symbol detection. The system check passes because OTFS admits single-antenna links. The medium is underwater acoustic, not radio, and no exclusion code covers it; the reviewer may confirm the scope. Table I cites FCDNN[10], CNN-FCDNN[13], ResNet[11], whereas the text and Fig. 5 cite [11], [14], [12]; the learned baselines are those earlier OFDM receivers, simulated here (p. 3).
